In sqlglot 15 the equivalent input produced a SetTag with an EQ whose LHS was a Column (table=foo, this=bar), i.e. dotted names were accepted as the assignment target. The current regression is that the LHS is restricted to a bare identifier rather than allowing a column/dotted identifier.
